_comment: TEMPLATE — not applied to any AWS account. This is the trust policy
(assume-role policy document) for the IAM role GitHub Actions assumes
via OIDC — paired with demo-setup/aws/ecr-least-privilege-policy.json
as that role's PERMISSIONS policy (trust = who can assume the role;
permissions = what the role can do once assumed — two separate
documents on purpose).
Assumes the GitHub OIDC provider
(token.actions.githubusercontent.com) has already been registered as
an IAM Identity Provider in this AWS account — a one-time, account-wide
setup step, not something this file creates. See MASTERCLASS.md for
the exact `aws iam create-open-id-connect-provider` command.
Replace <GITHUB_ORG>/<GITHUB_REPO> below with
jumptotechschooldevops/nexamarket-ecommerce before use — the
StringLike condition is what makes this trust relationship specific
to THIS repository rather than any GitHub Actions run anywhere.
Scoped to refs/heads/main only, not to pull_request runs: only
demo-setup/workflows/release.yml (push to main) ever calls
aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials — demo-setup/workflows/ci.yml
(pull_request) never touches AWS at all, so it has no business being
able to assume this role.
